issues.title: Missing: Strict-Transport-Security
issues.description: HSTS not set. Browsers can be tricked into HTTP connections (downgrade attack).
issues.fix: Add HSTS header to enforce HTTPS.
issues.apache_fix: Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload"

issues.title: Missing: Content-Security-Policy
issues.description: No CSP header. XSS attacks are not mitigated by the browser.
issues.nginx_fix: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self';" always;
issues.apache_fix: Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'"

issues.title: Missing: X-Frame-Options
issues.description: No X-Frame-Options. Site can be embedded in iframes (clickjacking risk).

issues.title: Missing: X-Content-Type-Options
issues.description: No X-Content-Type-Options. Browser may MIME-sniff responses into executable content.

issues.title: Missing: Referrer-Policy
issues.description: No Referrer-Policy. Full URL including query params may leak to third parties.

issues.title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS
issues.description: HTTP version of site is accessible without redirect to HTTPS.
issues.nginx_fix: server { listen 80; server_name example.com; return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }
issues.apache_fix:
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]

issues.title: robots.txt has no Disallow rules
issues.description: All paths are crawlable. Consider restricting admin/internal paths.

issues.title: Port 8080 (HTTP-Alt) is open
issues.description: Service HTTP-Alt on port 8080 is publicly accessible. Banner: None
issues.fix: Restrict port 8080 via firewall unless public access is required. Use VPN for admin services.

issues.title: Port 8443 (HTTPS-Alt) is open
issues.description: Service HTTPS-Alt on port 8443 is publicly accessible. Banner: None
issues.fix: Restrict port 8443 via firewall unless public access is required. Use VPN for admin services.

issues.title: Dangerous HTTP methods enabled: PUT, DELETE
issues.description: HTTP PUT, DELETE method(s) are accepted. PUT can upload files, DELETE can remove resources. Unless this is an intentional API, these should be disabled.
issues.fix: Disable PUT, DELETE methods unless needed for API functionality.

issues.title: No DMARC record found
issues.description: Without DMARC, email receivers cannot verify if emails from this domain are legitimate.
issues.fix: Add DMARC record: _dmarc.andy.cy. IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@andy.cy"

issues.title: No DKIM record found (common selectors checked)
issues.description: No DKIM signing detected. Emails cannot be cryptographically verified as authentic.
issues.fix: Configure DKIM signing in your mail server and publish the public key in DNS.

issues.title: Site can be embedded in iframes (clickjacking possible)
issues.description: No X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors. Attacker can overlay invisible iframe.
issues.fix: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.

issues.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
issues.description: Without CSP, the browser allows loading resources from any origin. XSS payloads can run freely.
issues.fix: Implement a strict CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

issues.title: No SQL injection indicators found (48 tests)
issues.description: No SQL error messages or timing anomalies detected. Basic SQL injection appears mitigated.

issues.title: 3 unprotected API endpoint(s) exposing data
issues.description: Open endpoints: /content/events.json, /content/links.json, /content/socials.json. These return JSON data without authentication.
issues.fix: Add authentication middleware to all sensitive API endpoints.

issues.title: No SQL injection found (92 tests on API endpoints)
issues.description: Extended SQLi testing on discovered API endpoints found no vulnerabilities.

issues.title: High-risk JavaScript sinks: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML assignment
issues.description: DOM manipulation functions that could lead to XSS: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML assignment.
issues.fix: Audit all uses of innerHTML/trustAsHtml/dangerouslySetInnerHTML for user-controlled input.

issues.title: Could not obtain test credentials
issues.description: Unable to register/login to test authentication vulnerabilities.

issues.title: Critical files exposed: /.git/HEAD, /.git/config, /.env, /.env.local, /.env.production
issues.description: Sensitive files accessible without authentication. May contain credentials, encryption keys, or configuration secrets.
issues.fix: Remove or restrict access to sensitive files. Configure web server to block access to non-public directories.
